She was the last person to see them. Padmé sent her here to safety.|Captain Gregar Typho|audio=ThisIsPeppiBow-BSV.flac|}} '''Peppi Bow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] herder living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Shortly after the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Gungan's herd became skittish when near Naboo's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]], in much the same way they had during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] [[32 BBY/Legends|ten years prior]]. Bow, concerned that the planet may be facing another invasion, contacted the leader of the Gungans, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], who brought her before the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]]. Bow explained to the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] that she feared [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had returned to Naboo—fears that were dismissed by much of the council. She was later vindicated when a patrol of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] intercepted a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Bow returned to her herd, most of which would later be killed after drinking from a river just outside of Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. She learned from Naboo [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] that her animals were the victims of a Confederate [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|biological weapon]] that had contaminated the river. Bow aided the two in locating the weapon's source, and after Amidala and Binks were captured by Confederate forces, she aided [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in locating the politicians. Bow and Tano discovered that they were being held in a secret Trade Federation [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] beneath the eastern swamps—the same laboratory where the [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] was developed. While Tano and Republic forces [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|assaulted]] the lab, Bow waited in the swamp above to prevent any Confederate forces from escaping the battle. At the end of the raid, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]], who was responsible for the bioweapon and the capture of Amidala and Binks, attempted to flee Republic forces, but was stopped by Peppi Bow after she tackled and incapacitated him. ==Biography== ===Life as a shaak wrangler=== {{Quote|Mesa shaaks, dey detectin' some-tin. Some-tin dey no liken at all.''"
"''Da last time dey bein' like dis?''"
"''Over ten years. When da mackineeks… when dey comin' to Naboo.|Peppi Bow and Boss Rugor Nass|''[[The Clone Wars: The Valley]]''}} Peppi Bow was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] native to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Prior the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she lived on the planet as a herder and wrangler of [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]]—domesticated animals indigenous to Naboo that were commonly used as livestock.{{DB|creature|shaak|shaak}} Bow resided in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], which was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which includes the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] mega-conglomerate.{{Film|I}} During the invasion, Bow's shaaks became skittish and unsettled when in proximity to the Federation's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]]. The invasion ultimately met with failure when [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] retook the capital from the Trade Federation. [[File:TheValley-Council.png|thumb|right|300px|Boss Nass introduces Peppi Bow to the Royal Advisory Council.]] For the following decade, Bow continued her life as a shaak wrangler, ushering her herd about the plains outside of Theed. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' she noticed that her shaaks became jumpy and skittish when they neared Naboo's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]]. Bow was deeply concerned, and so contacted the Gungan leader, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], and informed him of her worries. Nass arranged for Bow to be brought before the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] so she could explain her concerns directly the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo herself. At the time, the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|throne]] was occupied by Queen [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], who granted Nass and Bow an audience before her council. Before presenting their issue to the queen, the two Gungans waited within the throne room of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] while the council held their regular session. When Neeyutnee gave Nass the floor, the Gungan Boss introduced Bow to the Advisory Council and allowed the shaak wrangler to explain her findings herself. [[File:Peppi_and_Nass.png|thumb|left|330px|Boss Nass and Peppi Bow address the Royal Advisory Council.]] Although she was initially apprehensive about addressing the queen, Bow was able to speak before both Neeyutnee and the rest of the council after receiving encouragement from Nass. She informed the queen of her herd's strange behavior, which led Neeyutnee to believe it may be the result of predators invading the area. The Gungan insisted that the problem was not predators, but instead that her animals were detecting something in the swamps that caused them to be so jumpy. After Nass questioned her on the history of her animal's behavior, Bow explained that the last time they had acted so peculiarly was during the Trade Federation's invasion eleven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior. Both the queen and [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] were taken aback by the insinuation that Federation [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had returned to their planet, as the conglomerate had allied itself with the Confederacy in its war against the Republic. Since the Clone Wars supposedly posed no immediate danger to the peaceful world, both Bibble and [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Chrin]] of the Royal Naboo Security Forces challenged Bow's report, with Chrin going so far as to openly mock her claims. The officer explained to the court that if battle droids had come to Naboo, the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that the Security Force had placed throughout the countryside would have detected them. Nass defended Bow's claims and Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] reprimanded Chrin for speaking out of turn before volunteering to take a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Security Officer]]s out on a patrol of the plains near the eastern swamps in order to discern the truth. During their patrol, the officers intercepted and destroyed a squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and captured an intact [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]]. The incident confirmed Bow's suspicions and alerted the Naboo to the possibility of a Confederate invasion. ===Homeworld threatened=== {{Quote|Mesa come too!''"
"''No. Stay here and make sure no one escapes.''"
"''Hm. Okeeday.|Peppi Bow and Ahsoka Tano discuss the raid on Nuvo Vindi's lab|audio=MeesaComeToo-BSV.flac|}} After giving her report to the council, Bow returned to her herd. Together with her shaaks, the Gungan journeyed to a river on the plains outside of Theed. Her animals proceeded to drink from the river, but began to honk and snort in alarm. Just as Bow herself was about to drink some of the [[Water/Legends|water]], her animals began to fall to the ground, [[Death/Legends|dead]]. An alarmed Bow realized that the water was somehow contaminated and attempted to push the shaaks away from the river with her [[Electropole/Legends|electropole]], but was too late. Although only six of the animals died immediately, almost every other shaak in her herd fell ill and eventually perished. A short time later, Bow witnessed an approaching [[S-130 Shelter speeder|vessel]] touch down near the river. Unaware of its origins, Bow took cover behind a ruin on the river bank and watched as two individuals clad in [[Hazmat suit/Legends|hazardous materials suits]] inspected the bodies of her animals. The Gungan was suspicious of their intentions and so attacked them with her electropole; however, unbeknownst to Bow, the individuals were in fact Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], Padmé Amidala, and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who had returned to their planet to investigate the appearance of the battle droids. After forcing Amidala to the ground, Bow turned on Binks, striking him repeatedly before removing his air-tight [[Armor/Legends|helmet]]. As Binks panicked, Amidala recovered and pulled a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on Bow. At the senator's request, Bow returned the helmet to Binks, who swiftly placed it back over his head. [[File:Peppi_and_Jar_Jar.png|thumb|right|330px|Peppi Bow and Representative Jar Jar Binks]] Understanding that the two were just as concerned about the death of her herd as she, Bow informed Amidala and Binks that it was safe to remove their helmets, as the contamination was in the water only, and not the air. Once Amidala dropped her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and took off the protective head gear, Bow introduced herself to the two of them before being informed that it was a [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|virus]] that had killed her animals. Amidala explained that the virus originated in an area surrounded by [[Perlote tree/Legends|perlote trees]], which Bow was able to identify as the eastern swamps. She gave the two [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] directions to the region and offered to take them there, but Amidala insisted that Bow remain on the river bank and wait for Naboo Security Officers to escort her back to her home in Theed. The shaak wrangler agreed and waited while Amidala and Binks ventured into the swamps. Upon her arrival in Theed, Bow was informed that Amidala and Binks had gone missing while investigating the swamps. As she had been the last person to see the two, Bow was summoned to the Royal Palace to meet with Captain Typho. Typho took the Gungan to the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]], where the two of them met with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Bow explained to the three that Amidala and Binks had been searching for the source of the virus when they went missing. Skywalker ordered Tano to go with Bow into the eastern swamps to begin the search for the senator and representative, while he and Kenobi stayed in Theed to discuss the situation with Typho. Bow and Tano departed, riding one of the Gungan's few surviving shaaks to the swamps. During their journey, Tano was informed that the swamp hid a massive [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|underground laboratory]], which had been discovered by Amidala before her disappearance. As night fell on Naboo, the two arrived at the swamps and followed the footprints left by Amidala and Binks deep into the perlote [[Tree/Legends|trees]] until they inexplicably stopped. Dismounting their shaak, Bow and Tano attempted to investigate the area, but were interrupted when Bow was raised off the ground by a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] [[Scope/Legends|scope]] that suddenly extended upward under her feet from beneath the swamp's muddy floor. While Bow balanced on one foot atop the scope, Tano maneuvered around it to avoid detection. When she had an opportunity to hide herself and Bow from the scope, Tano jumped up and tackled the Gungan off the scope and threw her behind the base of a large tree. Once the scope descended back into the swamp floor, Tano contacted Skywalker and informed him of the situation in the swamp. The Padawan was ordered to detonate a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|bunker bomb]] at one of the laboratory's entrance hatches as a distraction for the forces within. Once that was complete, Kenobi and Skywalker would enter the lab with [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to rescue Amidala and Binks and negate the threat of the virus. Before Tano initiated the [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|operation]], Bow called her shaak mount to take cover with her behind the tree. While they waited there, Tano used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to place a thermal detonator over one of the lab's hatches. Once the detonator exploded and breached the lab, Tano prepared to enter, but was stopped by Bow, who wished to aid in the assault. The Jedi Padawan refused her request, instead ordering Bow to wait in the swamp above and to prevent any Confederate personnel from escaping the laboratory. [[File:Peppi_attacks_Vindi.png|thumb|left|330px|Peppi Bow attacks Doctor Vindi.]] Tano ventured into the complex, followed shortly by Kenobi, Skywalker, and their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. The raid lasted until the following morning, when Naboo's [[Naboo (star)/Legends|sun]] once again rose over the swamps where Bow waited. After rescuing Amidala and Binks, Skywalker and Kenobi pursued [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] to an underground landing pad in the laboratory complex. Vindi—the Confederate [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who developed the virus—planned to escape the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] pursuit by fleeing in a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]], but first tried to delay the two by throwing vials containing samples of the virus at them, which, if broken, would unleash a plague upon the planet. Kenobi safely caught all the vials, but was left within the lab when Vindi raised the landing pad upward through large [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] doors on the swamp floor. Bow was standing directly above the hangar as the doors began to split and open to reveal Vindi's escape [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and nearly fell into the widening maw. After jumping to safety, Bow watched as the landing platform brought Skywalker and Vindi into view. Although the Jedi had Vindi at [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] point, the doctor was unwilling to surrender and once again attempted to break a vial of the virus and release a plague upon Naboo. Because the doctor was distracted by his own glee for his apparent victory over the Jedi, he did not notice Bow as she climbed atop the landing platform. Just before Vindi was able to open the vial, the Gungan tackled him, causing him to drop both his case of vials carrying the disease as well as the individual vial he had almost opened. Skywalker prevented the individual vial from falling to the ground and breaking while Bow continued her assault on Vindi, striking him repeatedly with her electropole so as to prevent him from reclaiming his case filled with the virus. Despite being defeated, Vindi still laughed while claiming that [[Viral bomb/Legends|bombs filled with the virus]] were about to detonate within the laboratory. His claim proved false, however, as the explosives had already been deactivated by [[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|clone forces]]. At a later time during the Clone Wars, Peppi Bow once again encountered Representative Binks. The Gungan politician had returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to investigate criminals who had been stealing shaaks from local herds. Binks left Bow in order to continue his mission, shortly after which point the shaak herder was approached by Ahsoka Tano, who had come back to Naboo in order to locate Binks. As she was unable to find him herself, she sought the aid of Bow, who led her to the Representative.{{TCWA|Card Commander}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I'll never doubt the survival instincts of a shaak again, sir.''"
"''And see that you learn to trust the concerns of a neighbor too, Chrin.|Officer Chrin and Captain Gregar Typho discuss Bow and her herd|}} Peppi Bow was a humble [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Eye/Legends|eyed]], pink-skinned Gungan who bound her [[Haillu/Legends|long, floppy ears]] together behind her head. She stood at 2.01 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot/Legends|ft]], 7 in) and had a flexible neck. [[File:PeppiBowsHerdDies-BlueShadowVirus.png|thumb|right|330px|Peppi Bow attempts to save her shaaks.]] Although she lived in the Naboo capital city of Theed, Bow led a rural life,''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' spending her time alongside her shaaks in the Naboo countryside.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' Bow had an innate understanding of her herd's behavior and was rightly concerned upon noticing their wariness near the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]]. Although nervous about presenting her findings to the Royal Advisory Council, Bow was reassured by Boss Nass, who urged her to continue her report to the Naboo officials. Despite her efforts to forewarn the Naboo, Bow's herd represented the first casualties of the Confederacy's [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. She was quick to recognize that the river water was unhealthy and attempted to save her animals from drinking it, but the effects of the weapon were too fast to counteract. She had no knowledge of the virus, but Bow knew that her shaaks were too strong to have been killed by any naturally-occurring substance in the water. Determined to discover the source of the contamination,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' Bow assaulted Amidala and Binks under the belief that they may have been involved with the contagion. Upon discovering their true intentions, Bow offered to help the two, just as she later offered to assist Tano in locating and infiltrating the Confederate lab. She knew how to handle herself in dangerous situations and dutifully followed Tano's orders to remain outside the laboratory and aided in the capture of the man responsible for her herd's death—Doctor Nuvo Vindi. ==Skills and abilities== An experienced shaak herder,{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961f6f9ed7011f7098cb730005|text=Dataclip: Blue Shadow Virus|na=video file}} was knowledgeable in the fields of shaak husbandry and Naboo flora and fauna. She was talented in her agility.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' ==Equipment== {{Quote|Back! Back!|Peppi Bow whilst using her electopole to move her Shaak|}} Peppi Bow garbed herself in a small teal top of [[Gungan weave]] and a short, matching skirt worn over long pink trousers, dyed with [[pom-berry]] extract. Bow also carried a lengthy electopole, a [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]]-hide carryall, and donned a large, wide-rimmed conical [[Hat/Legends|hat]]. She had a fondness for chewing on straw while riding her shaak mount. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|She is a very rural Gungan female. She needed a different look from the other Gungans, so I put the stalk of wheat in her mouth to give her a farm girl look.|Wayne Lo, on Peppi Bow|}} The Gungan Peppi Bow was created for "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. In "Blue Shadow Virus," written by [[Craig Titley]], Bow is voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode017.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Blue Shadow Virus}} who has also voiced the [[Bettie-Bot VJ]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}} [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} and [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] for the series.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}} Bow's character design was done by artist [[Wayne Lo]], who saw her as more rural than other Gungans, and so provided her with a stock of wheat to chew on in order to achieve a "farm girl look." As the first female Gungan to be featured prominently in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' work, Bow presented several challenges to the design team, as they experienced difficulties in making a Gungan appear feminine. To supply her with proper gender identification, Lo put Bow's long ears behind her head in a clasp, akin to a [[Wikipedia:Ponytail|ponytail]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] Bow first appeared in both "Blue Shadow Virus" and [[The Clone Wars: The Valley|''The Valley'']], an issue of [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|weekly webcomic]] that was written by Pablo Hildago. Both released on [[February 13]], [[2009]].{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/comic/?book=season1#/?page=131|text=''The Clone Wars: The Valley'' (p.131)|nobackup=1}} In [[2011]],{{SWArchive|url=video/view/001169.html|text=Video: LEGO ''Star Wars III: The Clone Wars'' Webdoc #2|nobackup=1}} Bow was included in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] and [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] versions of ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', where she appeared as an unlockable character.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' ==Appearances==
